game.desc: Forza Motorsport 3 on Xbox 360 is a car simulation where you can drive up to 400 cars. Race through the various tracks, melt the asphalt and in the event of an accident, turn back the clock. The game also features an editor to create your own motorized rides and a video editor to film your exploits. A multiplayer mode for up to eight players is present.
